attr.title: Minecraft Bedrock
attr.desc: Lightweight single-screen Minecraft Bedrock launcher for PortMaster ARM systems. Capability-selected aarch64 and armhf backends; exact devices are best effort unless listed as validated. RGDS redirects to a separate dual-screen edition. Requires a legally acquired official APK; no game files or license bypass are included.
attr.inst: Launch once, then copy one official full APK, APKM/APKS/XAPK bundle, or complete official split set to ports/minecraftbedrock-data/apk/. Install it from the launcher. Use arm64-v8a on aarch64 or armeabi-v7a on armhf. PairIP/new-ABI 1.26 packages are unsupported.
attr.inst_md:
1. Launch **Minecraft Bedrock** once so the shared data layout is created.
2. Copy your official APK, APKM/APKS/XAPK bundle, or complete split set to `ports/minecraftbedrock-data/apk/`.
3. Choose **Install APK** and select the complete metadata-matched set.
4. Keep or remove the original installer after a successful install.

RGDS users must install the separate **Minecraft Bedrock RGDS** edition.

**NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.**
